name: Shadow Pact raises every Shield effect value by 50% (#2046)
contract: Shadow Pact 561227 is one effect: aura 108 with MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50%, over EffectSpellClassMask (1342177280, 0, 0) = word 0 bits 28 and 30, which is exactly the Bloodmage's shields: Blood Shield 504296, Vital Shield 504849/804309, Thick Pelt 556233 and Coagulated Shield 504897. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers applies SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS to every effect value. Tooltip: "Increases the effectiveness of your Shields by $s1%." Regression guard for native behaviour.
